crusadecraft.law.succession.primogenitur: The eldest child inherits the house, sons first.
crusadecraft.law.succession.egalitaire.d: The eldest child inherits, daughter or son.
crusadecraft.law.succession.anciennete.d: The oldest member of the house inherits.
crusadecraft.law.succession.elective.des:
The house picks its most notable adult (the one with the most traits).
The ambitious like it.
crusadecraft.news.succession: %s has died; %s succeeds them at the head of %s.
crusadecraft.codex.vie.p0: Time passes: every $(l)20 days$() of the world (configurable), everyone ages one year. Before 50, death is rare; then old age takes over, and nobody lives past 100. You, the player, do not age.
crusadecraft.codex.vie.p1: When the head of a house dies, the heir takes their place according to your realm's $(l)Succession$() law: primogeniture, equal, seniority or elective. The computer's rulers die too, and the world learns the name of their successor.
